title: Context receipt
description: Proves WHAT THE AGENT KNEW when it decided. Without it a verdict cannot be reproduced, because the inputs that produced it are unrecoverable. Canonical serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators (',',':'), no trailing newline. Digest is sha256 over those bytes, rendered 'sha256:<hex>'. Two spellings of one object must not produce two digests. Backward compatibility: additive optional fields are a minor bump; removing a field, narrowing an enum or making a field required is a MAJOR bump and a new $id.

expires_at.description: A context receipt expires. Stale context that never expires is how a decision made against a superseded tree keeps looking valid.
